key: folk:wolf:The Three O'Clock Stalker|crawler|camera|charcoal|A house in Leeds, 3:07 AM|

narrator.persona: a thirty-year-old software engineer reviewing old footage

sentences.text: My phone buzzed with a motion alert from the living room camera at exactly three-seven.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: The timestamp read three-seven every single night since Tuesday.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: I was shaking while watching the grey pixelated feed.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: The police said it was just a glitch in the software.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: Open the front door for me right now.
sentences.speaker: mimic

sentences.text: My grandmother passed away five years ago in this very room.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: On the screen, a long charcoal shape stepped closer to the camera lens.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: Two white eyes pressed right against the glass of the camera.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: Would you check the front door if you heard that voice tonight?
sentences.speaker: narrator
